system.name: CS-Probing (Coefficient Significance Probing)
system.one_liner: Probing study of neural combinatorial optimization models (AM, POMO, LEHD) that reads their hidden embeddings at fixed positions and analyses probe coefficients and significance.

content.variant_note: two encoder-decoder transformer solvers drawn in the same grammar, each tapped by red probe cones at fixed positions
content.argues: Both families of NCO solvers, one with its attention depth in the encoder and one in the decoder, expose embeddings at a few well-defined positions that can be probed.
content.subject: Block diagrams of the HELD (AM, POMO) and LEHD architectures from node features to next-node probabilities, with six probe positions marked.

lessons.what_to_learn: Mark the places where a model is read out by touching the exact arrow between two blocks with one saturated-colour glyph (a thin red cone) and a numbered label, on an otherwise pastel anatomy; draw two architectures in the same colour grammar so only the depth placement differs.
lessons.suits: Interpretability, probing or activation-extraction papers that tap hidden states of one or two network families at named positions.

summary: The paper probes neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) solvers to see what their hidden representations encode, and introduces CS-Probing. Figure 1 draws the two transformer-based architecture families that are probed. Panel (a) is the HELD structure of AM and POMO: a node-feature strip is linearly projected, passed through L attention layers into node embeddings, then a decoder of context embedding, multi-head attention, compatibility and softmax gives next-node probabilities. Panel (b) is LEHD, with one encoder attention layer and L attention layers in the decoder. Pastel boxes keep one colour per module type, dashed rounded regions mark encoder and decoder, and red tapered cones labelled P1 to P6 point at the arrows where embeddings are extracted.
summary_zh: 图1画出被探测的两类Transformer神经组合优化模型：(a) AM/POMO 的 HELD 结构，(b) LEHD 结构。淡色方框按模块类型着色，虚线框分编码器与解码器，红色细锥形 P1–P6 标出提取嵌入的探测位置。
notes: Pre-screen label 'red trumpet markers' confirmed: they are narrow red cones touching the arrow they read. The single placed bitmap (54 x 8 pt) is the red-to-lavender gradient of the Context Embedding box, not a data sample. The expansion of HELD and LEHD is not given in the figure; the drawing only shows the attention depth L in the encoder for (a) and in the decoder for (b).
